description: Search or browse Loaded.com (formerly CDKeys.com) for game keys, gift cards, memberships and top-ups.

category.description: Product category within the chosen platform. Not every category exists on every platform (e.g. Steam and Time Cards are PC-only, Season Passes is Xbox-only, Add-ons is PlayStation-only) — an unsupported combination falls back to Games.
category.title: Category (mode=byPlatform)

genre.description: Keep only products whose genre matches (e.g. `action`, `strategy`, `rpg`, `sports`, `shooter`, `horror`). Case-insensitive.
genre.title: Genre filter

inStockOnly.description: Only emit products currently in stock.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this (GBP).
maxPrice.title: Max price (GBP)

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products currently discounted below their regular price.
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

platform.description: Platform hub to browse (mode=byPlatform, required) or to filter results by (all other modes, optional).
platform.title: Platform

publisher.description: Keep only products whose publisher name contains this text (e.g. `ubisoft`, `ea`, `rockstar`). Case-insensitive.
publisher.title: Publisher filter

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search Loaded.com's catalog, e.g. a game title or franchise.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

sortBy.description: Result order (applies to every mode). Uses the store's own listing-page sort.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Loaded (CDKeys) Game Key Store Scraper Input
